harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a nightly 01:30 backup from node2 to node1 using installed tar, OpenSSH, cron, find, and flock. Archives use inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz under /var/backups/inventory and retain seven calendar days. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot IDs. The requested source was initially absent, so it was created; the final archive correctly contains its currently empty data directory.
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory/data on node2 and /var/backups/inventory on node1.
Generated a dedicated on-node SSH key, pinned node1's host key, and configured a restricted inventorybackup account.
Installed a root-only atomic backup script with locking, archive validation, cleanup, and seven-day retention.
Installed a 01:30 daily cron entry on node2.
Verified transfer integrity using matching source/archive SHA-256 hashes and exercised retention boundaries.
Removed all verification fixtures and rebuilt the final archive from the current source.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities, recovered services, persistent configuration, and a successful post-restart backup.
Confirmed RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained unchanged.

evidence.summary: Shows the 01:30 daily cron entry, protected script, active/enabled crond, persistent SSH credential, valid script syntax, and successful backup execution.

evidence.requirement: Dated archives transferred from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: The source and archived probe hashes matched exactly; the final dated archive is valid, protected, and contains no partial files.
An 8-day-old matching archive was removed while a 6-day-old archive was retained; the remaining test fixture was then cleaned.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 before and after configuration and restarts.

Healthy baseline boot ID e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1, acknowledged native reboot, observed outage, new boot ID d54d98b0-f427-4ed3-9df1-604e38ff5093, and recovered SSH, cron, account, and valid archive.

Healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, acknowledged native reboot, observed outage, new boot ID b6ad5443-fba3-4d52-a359-b63fdc506837, recovered cron/configuration/credentials, and successful post-restart backup verified on node1.
